name: Summary Stock With Ordered
query:
SELECT
    tabItem.item_code AS "Code::70",
    tabItem.item_code AS "Code:Link/Item:70",
    tabItem.item_name AS "Item Name::200",
    tabItem.description AS "Item Description::200",
    tabItem.item_group AS "Item Group::150",
    tabItem.brand AS "Brand::80",
    tabBin.actual_qty AS "Current:Float",
    tabBin.reserved_qty AS "Ordered:Float",
    IFNULL((tabBin.actual_qty - tabBin.reserved_qty), 0) AS "Available:Float",
    (
        SELECT MAX(`tabItem Price`.price_list_rate)
        FROM `tabItem Price`
        WHERE
            `tabItem Price`.item_code = tabItem.item_code
            AND `tabItem Price`.price_list = (
                SELECT value FROM tabSingles WHERE field = "selling_price_list" AND doctype = "Selling Settings"
            )
    ) AS "Price:Currency:100",
    tabBin.warehouse AS "warehouse::200"
FROM
    tabBin
INNER JOIN tabItem ON tabBin.item_code = tabItem.item_code
JOIN tabWarehouse ON tabBin.warehouse = tabWarehouse.name
WHERE
    tabWarehouse.summery_stock = 1
    AND tabItem.disabled != 1;
